translation_text_exact: I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and there I saw a deep valley with fire burning.[a]

footnotes_exact.text: Literally, “another face of the earth.” “Another part” preserves the selected word “other” and the geographic face/surface expression. The last clause describes the fire burning; it does not add a second observer or a separate numeral.

Initial wa is naturally not separately reproduced at the beginning of an English sentence. Another part is a contextually supported spatial rendering, with the literal face expression in the note. With fire burning is an English circumstantial construction, not an additional source finite verb or actor.
